reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V4 (final): imported tools/ladder.py and re-fit b, tau, K_us on their per-segment 50/50 train half with their hygiene mask, then applied V4 prediction (psi_dot = v/(L(1+K_us v^2)) * tan(delta_lag - b)) to all canonical Ford segments.
notes: V4 = (v / (L*(1+K_us*v^2))) * tan(delta_lag(tau) - b); fit on per-segment 50/50 time split of agent-hygiene-masked train half (matches REPORT). Fitted params: b=2.4458e-04 rad, K_us=4.4164e-04 s^2/m^2, tau=3 samples (60 ms). L per platform: Mach-E=2.984 m, F-150=3.70 m. Canonical filter is v>2.0 only (looser than agent's hygiene mask), so pooled RMSE is on a slightly bigger sample set. Sanity-check baseline RMSE differs from canonical by 1.83e-06.
